thread:
maria_sales: Quick presales sync for FinEdge POC. Customer asks: 30-day trial, ~10k queries/day, peak ~450 rps bursts, must have KMS-managed keys and SOC2 artifacts. They want an acceptance checklist (latency/cost/quality) + a pricing delta for reserved vs PAYG. Can someone own runbook + perf plan?

leo_se: I can take the runbook + deployment steps. Clarify: are they insisting on VPC peering day-1 or is hosted with CMK (customer-managed key) acceptable for initial soak?

nidhi_ml: Host + CMK should be fine to start. Model plan idea: baseline on redwood-mini-4q (fast, quantized) and route to redwood-medium when quality drops. Eval metrics we should capture: semantic relevance (>=90%), extraction accuracy (F1), and hallucination rate (<2% sampled).

maria_sales: They flagged cost target: <=$1k for 30 days. That feels tight but doable if we tune batching & caching. Need a conservative estimate and a reserved-capacity delta.

nidhi_ml: Load test proposal (three phases):
- warmup: 40 rps x 10m
- steady: 225 rps x 45m
- peak: 450 rps x 12m
Metrics to collect: p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cache hit rate, model-level tail latencies. If p95 >350ms we fallback to: increase batching windows, enable larger KV caching, or switch some traffic to redwood-medium. I'll produce cost simulation based on prompt-length buckets (short/med/long).

carlos_prod: Acceptance checklist (draft):
1) Quality: labeled eval set >=90% relevance and F1 for extraction tasks >=87%
2) Perf: p50 <=120ms, p95 <=350ms under the defined load profile
3) Cost: total POC spend <=$1,000 (customer wants cap)
4) Security: CMK/KMS, TLS, data retention & deletion docs, SOC2 Type II evidence available
5) Ops: runbook + oncall contact + rollback plan
If any perf gate fails we mark as "needs remediation" and list mitigation steps.

security_bot: Security issues recorded: customer requested SOC2 Type II report, KMS integration guide, VPC peering steps, and an explicit data retention + deletion statement. Reference: https://internal.docs.redwood/security/presales (upload artifacts to locker).

infra_ops: Infra notes: We can provision a short-lived reserved pool for the POC. Quick ballpark: PAYG (30d, current rates, given expected token counts) ~ $1.3k; 30d reserved trial (small commitment) could be ~35-45% lower -> estimate $700-$850. That's why they'll see a delta. I'll loop in billing for an exact quote. Also check GPU quota in us-west-2 before provisioning.

maria_sales: Owners & timeline:
- Leo (SE): runbook + infra steps (env ready by Thu)
- Nidhi (ML): eval harness + perf report (load tests Fri)
- Carlos (Prod): acceptance checklist + gating decisions
- Maria (Sales): NDA + sample data + customer coordination
Target: initial perf report by Mon. Flag any legal/quotas/billing blockers here. :white_check_mark:

leo_se: I'll draft runbook and attach network diagrams + CMK steps. Also will include a minimal curl example for quick smoke tests.

maria_sales: I'll follow up with customer to confirm sample dataset and whether VPC peering is strict. Thanks team — please ping if you hit infra limits or need additional telemetry. :rocket:
